meta.name: writing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求拆成分步执行计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到需求却不知从何下手
copy.tagline_en: Turn specs into step-by-step coding plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a spec but don't know where to start

howto.what: 用户给出多步任务的规格或需求后,Claude 会先声明使用本技能,再写出分步实施计划:每步含要改的文件、要写的测试和操作命令等,存到 docs/superpowers/plans/ 下,最后询问执行方式。
howto.when: 当你有规格或需求,要做多步任务且还没写代码时触发。

say.text: 根据这份需求文档,用 writing-plans 写实施计划。
say.note: 会生成分步计划并保存到 plans 目录。

say.text: 帮我先写实施计划再动代码,任务要小步可测。
say.note: 会按 TDD 拆成可独立测试的小任务。

say.text: 把下面的功能规格拆成分步计划,存到 plans 目录。
say.note: 计划含每步的测试和提交命令。

howto.what_en: Given a multi-step task spec, Claude announces using this skill, writes an implementation plan (per-task files, failing tests, commands), saves it under docs/superpowers/plans/, then offers execution options.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user has a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before writing any code.

say_en.text: Write an implementation plan from this requirements doc using writing-plans.
say_en.note: Plan is generated and saved to docs/superpowers/plans/.

say_en.text: Write the plan first, then code. Keep tasks small and testable.
Break this feature spec into steps and save the plan under plans dir.
say_en.note: Each step includes tests and commit commands.
